content.text: Make one complete artifact revision using the supplied current_state and repair_policy. Submit complete Python source and its declared parameter count using submit_candidate exactly once. No task execution, repair of your output, additional request, files, networks or subprocesses are available in this conversation. The host will evaluate separately under its frozen allocation. Any optional explanation is unverified archive-only text. The finish tool creates no candidate.

function.name: submit_candidate
function.description: Archive one strict complete submission. No source is executed or scored. Optional explanation remains archive-only.

function.name: finish
function.description:
Signals the completion of the current task or conversation.

Use this tool when:
- You have successfully completed the user's requested task
- You cannot proceed further due to technical limitations or missing information

The message should include:
- A clear summary of actions taken and their results
- Any next steps for the user
- Explanation if you're unable to complete the task
- Any follow-up questions if more information is needed
